item.title: AVID Medical, Inc.: Halyard convenience kits containing recalled Medline Namic Angiographic Star Off Handle Manifolds. SAMMC ANGIOGRAPHY SAMM066-15 Recall
item.product: Halyard convenience kits containing recalled Medline Namic Angiographic Star Off Handle Manifolds. SAMMC ANGIOGRAPHY SAMM066-15
item.summary: Affected kits contain Medline Namic Angiographic Star Off Handle Manifolds, which were recalled by the manufacturer due to presence of particulates within fluid path of the Manifolds. Particulate within the fluid path has the potential to be introduced into blood circulation and become lodged within blood vessels. Product details: Halyard convenience kits containing recalled Medline Namic Angiographic Star Off Handle Manifolds. SAMMC ANGIOGRAPHY SAMM066-15
item.affectedPeople: US Nationwide distribution in the states of NC and TX.
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
